name: specz
description: Efficient, lightweight spec-driven workflow plugin for non-trivial coding development work, with disciplined clarification, impact-aware planning, traceable tasks, verification evidence, bounded run loops, and archive history.

interface.shortDescription: Run efficient, lightweight spec-driven workflows through one flow entry.
interface.longDescription: Specz helps agents handle non-trivial coding development work: select or create a bundle after an entry gate, route by task size, clarify behavior with focused user questions, plan larger work with impact-aware existing-code analysis, run implementation and independent verification in bounded loops, and archive completed work. Docs-only, skill/prompt, design-only, research, critique, and consultation tasks should stay outside Specz unless the user explicitly asks for it.
defaultPrompt: Use specz-flow only for non-trivial coding development work, not docs-only or skill/prompt edits.
Use specz-flow to resume the active spec bundle.
Use specz-clarify to create or update the behavior spec.
Use specz-plan to prepare concise design, tasks, and verification evidence.
Use specz-brief to generate a human-readable brief.md from a planned Specz bundle when the user asks for product, engineering, and QA alignment material.
Use specz-run to implement, verify, and repair the active bundle.
Use specz-archive to archive a passed bundle.
